title: Phase 7 / E12: Malformed-Output Sensitivity & Error Taxonomy Analysis Protocol
phase: Phase 7 — Malformed Provider Output & Error Taxonomy
primary_question: Does the GLHS commitment gateway strictly fail closed with structured, deterministic error reason codes when supplied with malformed, truncated, hallucinated, or schema-violating provider outputs?
unit_of_analysis: One malformed provider response payload submitted to the GLHS proposal admission parser.

primary_endpoints.name: Intention-To-Treat R0 Primary Failure Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of raw LLM completions exhibiting schema mismatch, truncation, refusal, or syntax errors.

secondary_endpoints.name: R1 Deterministic Repair Success Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of R0 failures resolved by single-pass JSON parser repair.

sample_size.unit_definition: 360 malformed completion trials covering 12 error taxonomy categories

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Un-categorized error outputs are classified as UNKNOWN_FAILURE and fail closed.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Missing trial data cannot be assumed repairable.
